bioprojects.title: Genome sequence for Danio rerio (zebrafish), currently maintained by the Genome Reference Consortium (GRC)

genome_notes: superseded by newer assembly for species

attributes.name: note
attributes.value: combined sample of SAMN03014687-SAMN03014693, SAMEA3146246, SAMEA3642453

assembly_info.comments: The GRCz11 sequence is composed of genomic sequence, primarily finished clones that were sequenced as part of Zebrafish Genome Project at the Wellcome Trust Sanger Institute. PCR products and WGS shotgun sequence from mainly the WGS31 assembly (CABZ00000000.1) but also WGS29 (CAAK00000000.1) and WGS32 (CZQB00000000.1) have been added where necessary to fill gaps. In addition, unplaced sequences from WGS31 were added if they featured at least 5 kb of non-repetitive sequence, or if alignments with a cDNA could be detected that were not already covered by the placed sequences. For more information see: https://genomereference.org.
